# Bokeh blur

Blurs the whole frame through a round or hexagonal aperture, so highlights turn into soft discs or hexagons. For focus by distance, use depth of field.

<EffectDemo effect="bokeh-blur" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bokehBlur } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/bokeh-blur';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bokehBlur({ preset: 'dreamy' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.radius = 8`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type                  | Default    | Range     | Description                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `radius`               | number                | `8`        | 0 – 40 px | Radius of the aperture shape.                                            |
| `shape` _(structural)_ | 'circle' \| 'hexagon' | `'circle'` |           | Aperture shape.                                                          |
| `highlights`           | number                | `1`        | 0 – 4     | Extra weight for bright samples, which makes highlight shapes stand out. |
| `samples`              | integer               | `48`       | 8 – 128   | Samples per pixel; more give smoother shapes.                            |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `dreamy`  | `radius: 14`, `highlights: 2`                       |
| `hexagon` | `shape: 'hexagon'`, `radius: 12`, `highlights: 2.5` |
| `soft`    | `radius: 5`, `highlights: 0.5`, `samples: 32`       |
| `heavy`   | `radius: 28`, `samples: 96`                         |

Apply one with `bokehBlur({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 200.7 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Quality tiers:** low: `samples: 16`; medium: `samples: 32`; high keeps the effect's own values. Set `quality`, or leave it `auto` for an [adaptive composer](/guide/performance).
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/bokeh-blur`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Golden-angle spiral disk sampling with highlight weighting; hexagonal aperture by radial rescaling.

## Related

- [Depth of field](./depth-of-field) — Blurs what is nearer or farther than the focus distance, as a wide-aperture lens does.
- [Blur](./blur) — Blurs the whole frame with a separable Gaussian, a box filter, or iterated Kawase passes, optionally at reduced resolution for wide, cheap blurs.
- [Bloom](./bloom) — Light bleeding around bright areas.
